newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Dec-Feb unemployment unchanged at 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile Dec-Feb unemployment unchanged at 5.4 pct.

text.p: Chile's posted an unemployment rate of 5.4 percent in the December-February quarter, the same level as in the three months from November to January, said the National Statistics Institute.
The southern Eighth Region reported the highest unemployment rate of 6.7 percent, with the lowest rate, 1.2 percent, recorded in the far southern Eleventh Region.
The jobless rate in the capital Santiago was 6.3 percent.

The unemployment rate was 1.6 percent lower than in the December 1995-February 1996 quarter. But the figures are not strictly comparable as the government changed its method of calculating the data last year.
